about:
Killdeer Mountain Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1987 in Killdeer, North Dakota. The company maintains additional offices in Dickinson, Kerrville, Fargo, and Bismarck. Ownership structure and founders are not disclosed in public materials.

The company produces commercial and military cable assemblies and fiber optic bundles, incorporating first-rate materials to meet precise electrical, mechanical, and environmental requirements. Its capabilities include electrical wire harness fabrication and fiber optics technology, with experience on programs such as Boeing Wichita's 767-GTTA, Lockheed Martin U-2, Seyers, and Southwest. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

KMM serves the commercial aviation, military aviation, aerospace, and defense sectors. Named customers include Boeing, Lockheed Martin, and Southwest, with work on platforms such as the 767-GTTA and U-2.

The company emphasizes the use of first-rate materials and designs for high-grade performance, backed by established terms agreements with major primes including Boeing and Lockheed Martin.
